settings.title: Rings
settings.intro: Measure your finger at home in two minutes and pick the matching size.
settings.steps:
Wrap a thin strip of paper or string around the base of your finger.
Mark the point where the ends meet.
Lay it flat and measure the length in millimetres. This is your finger circumference.
Use the calculator or the chart to find your size.
settings.tips:
Measure at the end of the day, when your fingers are at their widest.
Between two sizes? Choose the larger one.
Wide rings fit a little tighter than thin ones.
Or measure a ring you already own: its inner diameter in mm is your size.

settings.title: Bracelets
settings.intro: A bracelet should move gently on your wrist without slipping over your hand.
settings.steps:
Wrap a strip of paper or string around your wrist, just above the wrist bone.
Mark where the ends meet and measure the length in centimetres.
Add 1.5 - 2 cm for a comfortable fit.
Compare the result with the chart.
settings.tips:
Many of our chain bracelets are adjustable, so you can fine-tune the length.
For a bangle, measure the widest part of your hand with the thumb tucked in.

settings.title: Necklaces
settings.intro: The length decides where your necklace rests, so pick the style that suits your neckline.
settings.table_rows:
Choker | 35 - 40 | Base of the neck
Princess | 40 - 46 | Collarbone
Matinee | 50 - 60 | Just above the bust
Opera | 70 - 80 | Below the bust
settings.steps:
Measure a necklace you already wear and love, from clasp to clasp.
Or lay a piece of string around your neck at the length you want and measure it.
Choose the nearest length in the chart.
settings.tips:
Our initial necklaces are 40 - 46 cm and adjustable.
Layering? Pick lengths about 5 cm apart.
